WITH city_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        LEAST(f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport) AS city1,
        GREATEST(f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport) AS city2,
        a1.coordinates AS coord1,
        a2.coordinates AS coord2
    FROM flights f
    JOIN airports_data a1 ON f.departure_airport = a1.airport_code
    JOIN airports_data a2 ON f.arrival_airport = a2.airport_code
),
distances AS (
    SELECT
        city1,
        city2,
        6371 * 2 * ASIN(
        SQRT(
            POWER(SIN((coord1 -> 'lat') - (coord2 -> 'lat')) / 2, 2) +
            COS((coord1 -> 'lat')::REAL) * COS((coord2 -> 'lat')::REAL) *
            POWER(SIN((coord1 -> 'lon') - (coord2 -> 'lon')) / 2, 2)
        )) AS distance
    FROM city_pairs
),
avg_distances AS (
    SELECT
        city1,
        city2,
        AVG(distance) AS avg_dist
    FROM distances
    GROUP BY city1, city2
),
binned_distances AS (
    SELECT
        city1,
        city2,
        CASE
            WHEN avg_dist <= 0 THEN 0
            WHEN avg_dist <= 1000 THEN 1000
            WHEN avg_dist <= 2000 THEN 2000
            WHEN avg_dist <= 3000 THEN 3000
            WHEN avg_dist <= 4000 THEN 4000
            WHEN avg_dist <= 5000 THEN 5000
            ELSE 6000
        END AS range
    FROM avg_distances
),
range_counts AS (
    SELECT
        range,
        COUNT(*) AS pair_count
    FROM binned_distances
    GROUP BY range
)
SELECT
    range,
    pair_count

    ROUND(MAX(vwd.`whsle_px_rmb-kg`), 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MIN(vwd.`whsle_px_rmb-kg`), 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
